big: Nifty Smallcap 100 is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Smallcap 100 track?
The Nifty Smallcap 100 Index is designed to reflect the behaviour and performance of the small cap segment of the financial market. It holds 100 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
